title: Calm, clever and hard to put down
review: A lovely little puzzle game for winding down. The puzzles are satisfying, the flower show is beautiful, and I always end up playing longer than planned.

title: My new wind-down game
review: Really chilled and easy to pick up. I can play for five minutes or get completely carried away. The flower displays are a lovely touch too.

title: Surprisingly addictive
review: I thought I would have one quick go. That did not happen. The puzzles are simple to understand but keep you coming back, and the whole thing feels wonderfully relaxing.

title: Beautiful and relaxing
review: The colours, flowers and gentle pace make this such a nice game to play when I want to switch off. There is enough challenge to keep it interesting without feeling stressful.

title: Just what I needed
review: A fun little puzzle game that does not shout at you. It is calm, satisfying and slightly addictive in the best way. I really look forward to seeing the next flower display.

title: The flowers are gorgeous
review: The puzzles are fun, but I stayed for the flower show. Watching it come together is oddly satisfying, especially after a busy day. Very relaxing and easy to lose track of time with.

title: Great for five minutes or an hour
review: Perfect for picking up whenever I have a spare moment. The puzzles feel rewarding, the design is lovely, and the relaxed pace makes it easy to keep playing.

title: Simple idea, lots of fun
review: Easy to learn and harder to stop playing than I expected. It has that rare mix of being peaceful and properly addictive. The flower show is a brilliant bonus.

title: Perfect before bed
review: A genuinely calming puzzle game. No pressure, no frantic timers, just nice little challenges and beautiful flowers appearing as you play. My favourite way to unwind at night.

title: Quietly brilliant
review: This game has a very nice rhythm to it. A few puzzles, a little progress, then another lovely flower display. It is relaxing, but there is always one more level I want to try.
